evidence.curator_note: exo head-to-tail isomer (d), here protonated on the ETHER oxygen (drawn as O5(+)(H)(C2H5); the ketone C1=O2 is left free because the exo geometry prevents the intramolecular O...H+...O chelation that stabilises the endo isomer (c)). Arrow label 'i' (inductive cleavage): the C4-O5 bond breaks heterolytically, ethanol departs with the bonding pair, and C4 becomes a secondary bicyclic carbocation, giving (MH - C2H5OH)+ as the base peak (100%). Book draws 1 arc (the C4-O5 bond breaking toward the departing ethanol). One move, fully drawn. Precursor connectivity is the head-to-tail regiochemistry of (c)/(d) (ethoxy carbon C4 adjacent to the fusion carbon C9 remote from the carbonyl); the product ion (MH - C2H5OH)+ is written only as a formula label on the page, so no product structure is drawn -- the bare C4 carbocation shown here is the curator's minimal faithful representation.

No MØD rule cross-links this scheme: rule_index.json by_equation has no entry for 8.30 (it covers only 4.x and 8.1-8.14). The page prints '100%' for (MH - C2H5OH)+; its m/z 109.0648 (C7H9O+) is a curator computation (MH+ 155.107 minus C2H6O 46.042). The related endo isomer (c) is drawn as a very stable proton-chelated MH+ ([O...H+...OEt], 100%) that does NOT fragment and carries no reaction arrows, so it is not encoded as a mechanism record. Termont et al. 1977 as cited.
